column1: # EU Building Stock Observatory (BSO) -- Italy residential indicators
# Used by 03_heat_intensity.py for (1) the unknown-cohort stock-weighted
# fallback intensity (stock_pct_it column) and (2) the BSO reconciliation row.
# stock_pct_it: share of the Italian residential stock by construction cohort.
#   Italy has a large pre-1991 stock. Distribution approximated from ISTAT
#   census data and Odyssee-Mure Italy. Sums to 100.
#   heat intensity (delivered). DERIVED from the Italian TABULA per-cohort
#   class-average space-heating need x retrofit blend (0.889) + DHW. The EU
#   Building Stock Observatory portal could not be queried directly; flagged as
# Source: ISTAT census; Odyssee-Mure Italy; Italian TABULA (it_intensities.csv).
